verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list continuous batching and chunked prefill as core features ([vllm-docs-3]), and the site says advanced scheduling and continuous batching keep GPU utilization at its peak ([vllm-docs-16]). Community users independently confirm that continuous batching and KV caching/chunking are central to its performance ([vllm-comm-3], [vllm-comm-4]), and a built-in benchmark CLI measures serving throughput ([vllm-docs-29]). missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on chunked prefill configuration and tuning, quantified throughput results in the evidence.
